set.body: Implement the cross-built surface data model: VertexId/FaceId opaque ids or equivalent, Hemisphere and SurfaceKind ADTs, TriangleMesh, SurfaceGeometry, and SurfaceError/smart constructors where useful. Acceptance: constructors validate coordinate dimensionality, face arity, finite coordinates, nonnegative/in-range indices, 4x4 surfaceToWorld affine, and basic derived counts; tests cover valid tetrahedron plus invalid meshes. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Surface core domain types
